notes: Read all 251 source lines before porting. tourRegistry.ts is a non-visual onboarding-tour registry: types + localStorage-backed completion helpers + route-match logic + CustomEvent dispatch helpers + the tour registry object. Only three seams are browser-bound (window.localStorage, the same-document window CustomEvent, and the 8 `@/features/onboarding/tours/*` imports of which only drivesTour is ported); everything else is platform-agnostic TypeScript ported 1:1 (contract rules 6 + 7).

L1 `import type { TourStep } from '@/hooks/useTour'`: useTour is not yet in the native parity layer, so the TourStep contract is reproduced locally (target/title/description/placement/onShow?/onHide?) and exported — the same self-contained approach the sibling drivesTour.ts + TourOverlay.tsx ports use. Data shape unchanged.

L3-21 module doc preserved (per-feature tours, routeMatch launcher hint, version-bump invalidation, the two storage keys `teslasync:tour:v{version}:{id}` and `teslasync:tour:list-seen`); a native-conversion section was appended documenting the three native-safe seams (storage, events, registry).
L23 `export type TourCompletionStatus = 'completed' | 'skipped'` ported verbatim.

L25-57 `export interface TourDefinition` ported verbatim with all JSDoc (id, routeMatch string|RegExp, titleKey, titleFallback, descriptionKey, descriptionFallback, version, steps: TourStep[], optional autoStart predicate).
L59-63 `export interface TourAutoStartContext { pathname; vehicleCount }` ported verbatim.

L65-70 STORAGE_PREFIX='teslasync:tour', LIST_SEEN_KEY=`${STORAGE_PREFIX}:list-seen`, and `storageKey(id, version)` returning `${STORAGE_PREFIX}:v${version}:${id}` ported verbatim — the exact key contract is unchanged.

L73-82 `getTourStatus`: the `typeof window === 'undefined'` guard + `window.localStorage.getItem` are replaced by `safeTourStorage()` over a structural `TourStorage`; the raw==='completed'||'skipped' return-literal check and the try/catch->null fallback are identical. Null-storage short-circuit returns null (same observable as the web no-window path).
L85-87 `isTourCompleted` ported verbatim (getTourStatus !== null).

L90-97 `markTourCompleted` + L100-107 `markTourSkipped`: window guard -> `if (!ls) return`; `ls.setItem(storageKey(id, version), 'completed'|'skipped')` in try/catch with the verbatim quota/non-fatal comments.

L110-126 `resetTour`: the `window.localStorage.length` / `window.localStorage.key(i)` / `removeItem` key-iteration is ported 1:1 against the seam's `ls.length` / `ls.key(i)` members (TourStorage models length + key for exactly this), preserving the prefix `teslasync:tour:` + suffix `:${id}` startsWith/endsWith filter and the forEach removeItem; whole body in try/catch (non-fatal).

L128-146 `resetAllTours`: same prefix-only key-iteration ported 1:1, INCLUDING the verbatim legacy `ls.removeItem('teslasync-tour-completed')` removal and its pre-Prompt-65 dashboard-auto-start-re-enable comment.
L148-156 `hasSeenTourList` + L158-166 `markTourListSeen` ported 1:1 over the seam: getItem(LIST_SEEN_KEY)==='true' / setItem(LIST_SEEN_KEY,'true') with try/catch false/non-fatal fallbacks.

L168-175 `isRecommendedForRoute` ported VERBATIM (pure logic, no DOM): string routeMatch -> exact '/' check or `pathname===m || pathname.startsWith(`${m}/`)`; RegExp routeMatch -> routeMatch.test(pathname).
L177-189 `TOUR_START_EVENT='teslasync:tour:start'` + `TOUR_OPEN_LAUNCHER_EVENT='teslasync:tour:openLauncher'` kept verbatim with their JSDoc. L191-193 `TourStartEventDetail { id }` ported verbatim.

L195-201 `dispatchTourStart(id)` + L203-207 `dispatchTourLauncherOpen()`: the web `if (typeof window === 'undefined') return; window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(TOUR_*_EVENT, { detail }))` is replaced (contract rule 7) by notifying an in-process subscriber registry (the native analog of the same-document CustomEvent) PLUS a best-effort mirror onto a detected global event dispatcher via emitGlobalTourEvent(), so a react-native-web consumer using `window.addEventListener` still receives the signal with the same detail. CustomEvent + dispatchEvent are typed structurally (DOM lib absent), mirroring the broadcast.ts port. Added native-analog subscribeTourStart / subscribeTourLauncherOpen (the native `window.addEventListener` equivalent) so native consumers can listen; no subscriber is on both channels so there is no double delivery.

L209-229 the registry: web statically imports 8 tours from `@/features/onboarding/tours/*`. Only drivesTour is ported into the native parity layer, so DRIVES_TOUR is imported for real from '../features/onboarding/tours/drivesTour' (verbatim relative path, real 4-step data). The other 7 (main, alerts, charging, vehicles, automations, settings, debugger) are not yet ported; a static import of a non-existent native module would not type-check, so each resolves to a native-safe placeholder built by unportedTour() carrying the REAL verbatim metadata read from the web tour sources (id / routeMatch / titleKey / titleFallback / descriptionKey / descriptionFallback / version, plus main's pure `autoStart: ({pathname, vehicleCount}) => pathname === '/' && vehicleCount > 0` and main's version 2 / alerts+charging+vehicles+automations+settings+debugger version 1) with empty steps (the unported UI walkthrough). TOURS keeps all 8 keys; a future pass swaps each placeholder for the real import — the dashboard widget-registry (registry/vehicle.ts) not-yet-ported pattern.
L231-241 `TOUR_ORDER` (main, vehicles, drives, charging, alerts, automations, settings, debugger) ported verbatim as `readonly string[] ... as const`.
L243-246 `getTour(id)` returns `TOURS[id] ?? null` verbatim. L248-251 `listTours()` maps TOUR_ORDER -> TOURS[id] and filters with the `(d): d is TourDefinition => Boolean(d)` type-guard verbatim.

Browser-only dependency handling (contract rule 7): localStorage seam adds an exported TourStorage interface + setTourStorage() host-injection point + TOUR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE_REASON (auto-detects global localStorage for full react-native-web parity; pure native reads 'not yet seen' and no-ops writes, exactly the web Web-Storage-unavailable fallback). Event seam replaces the same-document window CustomEvent with an in-process registry + a best-effort global CustomEvent mirror. Registry seam replaces 7 not-yet-ported static imports with metadata-faithful placeholders. No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, or web UI components are imported — only the already-ported native drivesTour module. Style matches .prettierrc.js (singleQuote, trailingComma all, arrowParens avoid, semicolons). Verified via: cd apps/native; npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
